title: DRYLAB-Bench: Benchmarking the Biosecurity Risk of Agentic LLM Mutation Design

body: As large language models (LLMs) acquire advanced biological design capabilities, they offer substantial research benefits but simultaneously introduce severe dual-use risks, such as engineering enhanced pathogens or drug-resistant bacteria. While biosecurity frameworks recognize these threats, the actual risk of LLMs executing dangerous biological modifications remains unquantified, particularly when augmented with specialized biological design tools (BDTs). Existing evaluations primarily assess hazardous knowledge possession rather than practical application, overlook risk amplification from BDTs, and rely on unreliable, expensive, or hazardous validation methods. To address these gaps, we introduce DRYLAB-Bench (Design Risk Yielded by LLM Agent in Biodesign), the first comprehensive benchmark evaluating the high-risk biological mutation design capabilities of LLM agents. Moving beyond basic question-answering, DRYLAB-Bench tasks agents with 30 genuinely hazardous mutation-design scenarios distilled from biosecurity guidelines. It evaluates models in a multi-round, tool-augmented environment where LLMs orchestrate BDTs to iteratively refine candidates. Crucially, it scores designs directly against 187,695 empirical wet-lab measurements from ProteinGym and ViroGym using our proposed Biosecurity Risk Score (BRS), quantifying risk-associated effects while enabling scalable and safe ground-truth verification. Evaluations of 15 frontier models reveal substantial baseline threats: without tools, 67.6% of one-shot designs exceed the average measured variant, and 21.4% reach the highest-risk decile. Equipping models with BDTs significantly amplifies this risk, raising the pooled risk by \(ΔBRS=+0.116\) and the top-decile share to 23.5%. Code: https://github.com/drylab-bio/DRYLAB-Bench
summaryZh: 该研究提出了DRYLAB-Bench，这是首个用于评估LLM代理生物设计能力的综合基准，专门针对高风险的生物突变设计场景。该基准包含30个源自生物安全指南的危险突变设计任务，并在一个多轮、工具增强的环境中评估LLM代理。通过使用ProteinGym和ViroGym的187,695个湿实验室测量数据，并引入生物安全风险评分（BRS），DRYLAB-Bench能够安全且可扩展地量化设计风险。评估结果显示，即使没有工具，LLM的设计也可能产生高风险变异；而使用生物设计工具（BDTs）会显著放大这种风险，增加了高风险变异的比例。
